---
name: Work Order
about: Scope a bounded research, experiment, documentation, or implementation assignment
title: "P0: "
---

## Outcome and completion criterion

State the useful result and observable completion criteria.

## Assignment

Role label, input revision, dependencies, output scope, allowed operations, and stopping point. Prepared does not mean launched.

## Evidence

Required primary sources, experiments, fixed Submission identity, and reproducible checks.

## Review

Fresh-context review route and critical PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED criteria. Identify who decides acceptance and who may merge.

## Resources and publication

Operating allowance or explicit one-deliverable scope; installations/model calls/services permitted or excluded; sanitization needed for public publication. No credentials or raw environment reports.
